item.title: Endress+Hauser Acquires Specialist in Inline Particle Measurement
item.description: The acquisition adds technology to analyze particles in real-time processes to Endress+Hauser’s process analysis portfolio.

item.title: Why Humanoid Robots May Be the Wrong Bet for Industrial Automation
item.description: Humanoid robots promise revolutionary automation, but their complexity, instability and safety gaps may outweigh the appeal of human-shaped machines.

item.title: How ABB Is Digitally Transforming Legacy Control Systems Without Disrupting Production
item.description: In this episode, we connect with Stefan Basenach, senior vice president of automation technology at ABB, to learn how ABB's new dual-environment architecture, called Automation Extended, enables the integration of AI, predictive maintenance and cybersecurity upgrades while protecting reliable core control functions in the distributed control system.

item.title: Quiz: How to Transform Processing Industries' Asset Management
item.description: How does data integrity, predictability and performance optimization help advance digitalization?

item.title: Yokogawa Partners with Anybotics for Automated Industrial Inspections
item.description: Anybotics is integrating Yokogawa’s robotics software to conduct autonomous inspections across industries.

item.title: How to Blend OT Expertise with Custom Software Development
item.description: Traditional manufacturing software platforms like SCADA, MES and historians are powerful, but custom software is filling the gaps configuration alone can no longer cover.

item.title: Why Manufacturers Are Demanding Smarter, More Adaptable Industrial Robots
item.description: Adaptable robotic systems incorporating AI, new vision tech and low-code programming are being used to tackle frequent product changeovers and a variety of production tasks by manufacturers of all sizes.

item.title: AI Motion Control and Predictive Maintenance
item.description: Find out how AI continuously adapts motion control to changing conditions such as load, friction and temperature to optimize motion profiles in real time enabling tighter control at higher speeds, lower energy consumption and extended equipment life.

item.title: ABB Launches SaaS Version of its Energy Optimization Platform
item.description: This new version was developed to provide operators with greater flexibility in the deployment, scaling and operation of energy and process optimization applications.

item.title: Why Even the Most Automated Factories Still Need the Human Touch
item.description: As dark factories and AI-driven automation advance, human oversight remains essential to building resilient, adaptable manufacturing operations.
